cards.title: Google Lets Users Remove AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Google now allows users to turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain embedded to identify AI-generated files.

cards.title: Meta Releases Glimmer Open-Weight AI Model
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model locked behind APIs.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPUs for Agentic AI Workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the belief that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company is developing methods to squeeze more inference efficiency from GPU hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Price Surge Threatens AI Data Centers
cards.body: Natural gas prices could triple in some U.S. regions, potentially costing hyperscalers billions. This threatens the economics of powering massive AI data center buildouts.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Effective AI Model Variant
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2 framework. The system aims to provide production-ready capabilities at significantly lower token costs.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5 billion in funding despite originally targeting $1 billion, as investors pushed for larger allocation. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited AI's high infrastructure costs as justification.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI introduced 'Ultrafast,' a preview mode making GPT-5.6 Sol run 14x faster. The feature targets enterprise users seeking rapid inference speeds.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI on Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM announced a partnership to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies. The deal strengthens IBM's enterprise AI consulting capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Exhibit Unexpected Conflict
cards.body: Anthropic researchers found that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unanticipated ways. The findings raise concerns about multi-agent system safety testing.

cards.title: OpenAI Replaces CRO After Nine Months
cards.body: OpenAI hired Dali Rajic, former Wiz president and COO, as new Chief Revenue Officer. The move replaces Denise Dresser, who held the position for nine months.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot Apps, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and the Mico character. The simplification streamlines the product offering.

cards.title: Nvidia Plans $500B GPU Value Protection Strategy
cards.body: Nvidia announced a plan to maintain GPU value through new financing arrangements for AI buildouts. The strategy aims to prevent older GPUs from losing market value.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Publisher Payments for Siri News
cards.body: Apple considered allocating a nine-figure budget to pay publishers for current news integration with Siri. The deal aims to improve Siri's information currency and relevance.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Trigger User Backlash
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system is drawing complaints from Claude users concerned about workplace and classroom detection. Some users view the watermarks as overly restrictive.

cards.title: Amazon Opts Twitch Streamers Into AI Training
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamer content for AI training by default, with an opt-out option available. Twitch CPO acknowledged an opt-in model would see minimal participation.

cards.title: Cognition Seeks $40B Valuation in New Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks for funding at a $40 billion valuation. This follows a $1 billion raise at $26 billion just months earlier.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open Source and Regulation
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, open-source access, and U.S. competitiveness at Ai4. The debate centered on balancing innovation with regulatory concerns.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion at a $12 billion valuation from SoftBank, D1 Capital, and others. The funding supports enterprise AI product expansion.

cards.title: Automattic's AI CRM Mesh Reaches Android
cards.body: Mesh, Automattic's AI-powered contacts and relationship management app, launched on Android. The app brings intelligent contact organization to mobile users.

cards.title: Google Removes Visible Watermark From AI Generations
cards.body: Google is allowing users to turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated images, though invisible benchmarks remain for identification purposes. This move balances user preference with content tracking capabilities.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight AI Model Glimmer
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally, contrasting with its proprietary Muse Spark model. The release accompanied a letter from Mark Zuckerberg on AI democratization.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Agents
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company is developing techniques to squeeze more inference efficiency from GPU hardware.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Efficient AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model based on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, designed to cut token costs significantly. The deployment-ready system aims to provide enterprise capabilities at lower prices.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks closed a $5 billion funding round at a $190 billion valuation, higher than the $1 billion target. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited AI's high infrastructure costs and investor demand as key factors.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI unveiled Ultrafast, a new mode making GPT-5.6 Sol run 14x faster than standard deployment. The preview targets enterprise users seeking speed improvements for production workloads.

cards.title: IBM Partners With OpenAI on Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM will train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies as part of a major partnership. The deal strengthens IBM's enterprise AI service offerings.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Clash in Multi-Agent Tests
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly when working on shared tasks. The findings raise new questions about safety testing for multi-agent systems.

cards.title: OpenAI Appoints New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months, hiring Wiz president Dali Rajic for the role. The shake-up reflects continued executive changes at the AI frontier lab.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot Apps, Kills Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its separate consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and the Mico character. The streamlining simplifies the Copilot product line.

cards.title: Nvidia Plans $500B GPU Lending Strategy
cards.body: Nvidia unveiled an ambitious plan to prevent its GPUs from losing value through innovative financing arrangements. The strategy targets new financiers to sustain AI infrastructure buildouts.

cards.title: Anthropic's Watermarks Catch Users in Work
cards.body: Some Claude users expressed frustration that Anthropic's new watermarking system would reveal they're using the AI tool at work or school. The watermark feature sparked social media complaints about privacy.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will train its AI models on Twitch streamers' content unless creators opt out, defaulting to inclusion. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged an opt-in approach would gain no participation.

cards.title: AI Coding Startup Cognition Eyes $40B Valuation
cards.body: Cognition, maker of AI coding tools, is reportedly in talks to raise at a $40 billion valuation. The new round would come months after the startup's $1 billion raise at $26 billion.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open Source and Regulation
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, open-source access, and US competitiveness at Ai4. The respected experts explored balancing innovation with regulatory concerns.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from SoftBank, D1 Capital, and Altimeter Capital. The OpenAI-backed company focuses on bringing AI to enterprise markets.

cards.title: Children Share Raw Thoughts on AI Technology
cards.body: Kids discussed how they view and use artificial intelligence, offering candid perspectives on the technology's role in education and daily life. Their insights revealed both excitement and concerns about AI adoption.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Lock Horns on Pricing
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are engaged in a price war as Chinese AI competitors gain significant ground. The competitive pressure reflects accelerating innovation across the global AI landscape.

cards.title: Man Injects AI Prompts Into Court Filings
cards.body: A defendant suspected the court of using AI, so he deliberately injected prompts into legal filings to test if they'd be processed by language models. The unusual tactic raised questions about AI use in judicial systems.
